messages:
inc-bot: [ALERT] INCIDENT STARTED — KVINDEX_HEAP_SURGE at 2401234567. Severity: P1. Autoscale not enough; memory growth observed on hosted-runtime cluster r12.
aj: saw the page, looking now. which shard?
devin: r12-gpu-3 (hosted-prod-us-west). heap growth traced to kv-index entries exploding after a long prompt burst from a customer.
samira: any immediate customer impact surfacing?
marie: yes — increased tail latency for text-gen on model: redwood/open-rt-7b, about 10% error-rate on some endpoints. customers seeing 5xx and timeouts.
sre_lead: oncall here. aj you have runbooks? start ringdown.
aj: pulling logs, running quick query: `SELECT count(*) FROM kv_index WHERE last_access > now() - interval '10 minutes' AND ttl IS NULL;` returns 1.2M entries on that node.
lucas: that aligns with continuous-batching prefetched prefixes not getting evicted — looks like a prefetch depth regression after yesterday's scheduler bump.
eng-runtime-bot: Deploy 2401234001 started to r12 at 2401234001 by ci/cd. Change: continuous-batcher default prefetch_slots: 16 -> 128.
aj: oh, that increase is the smoking gun. prefetch_slots x8.
devin: rolling rollback to previous config across r12 nodes. I'll open a canary and patch the config.
samira: notify customers in impacted cohort? pm_ted: we need to scope before external comms. which customers hit 5xx?
marie: two larger tenants (acme-analytics, parallax-ai) show errors; both are heavy long-prompt users. others rate-limited but degraded.
aj: mitigation plan: 1) scale up eviction aggressiveness 2) rollback prefetch_slots to 16 3) restart runtime processes on affected hosts 4) enable temporary request-shedding for very large context > 200k tokens.
sre_lead: execute steps 1 and 2 now. aj, devin take lead. lucas help with eviction tuning. samira on customer triage.
devin: applying config rollback via `rehash-config --cluster r12 --set continuous_batcher.prefetch_slots=16`
eng-runtime-bot: Config rollback request accepted. Patch id: cfg-240123-rollback.
aj: applied on canary r12-gpu-2. monitoring memory. canary heap dropped 35% in 45s.
marie: errors on canary decreased to near baseline, latency improving.
samira: starting outreach — sending internal note to customer-success with affected list. draft: "We're investigating intermittent timeouts; temporary mitigations underway. We'll follow up."
pm_ted: hold external templated comms. wait until we confirm rollback across cluster and check for regressions.
lucas: eviction tweak ready: `evict_policy: aggressive`, `kv_ttl_default: 10m` — pushing to affected nodes now.
devin: applied eviction tweak. memory trending down cluster-wide.
aj: now doing gradual process restarts to sweep older KV memory. doing 5 hosts at a time to stay under SLA.
eng-runtime-bot: Rolling restart job 240123-restart started.
marie: monitoring: error-rate dropping from 10% -> 1.2% across 10m window. customer requests flowing.
samira: opened private thread with CS to queue customers for follow-up once stable.
pm_ted: we should get a postmortem and consider reverting the scheduler bump until we have evaluation on long-context workloads.
sre_lead: agreed. immediate rollback is done, HH (hotfix) is in place. Next: validate that prefetch slots change doesn't create capacity drop.
aj: running canary load tests simulating long prompts now. initial results: throughput down 8% but tail latency within SLO for typical prompts.
devin: created short-term guardrail: if request context length > 150k -> reject with 413 and suggest chunking. Patch deployed to gateway.
marie: customers hitting long contexts will see clear error and guidance instead of timeouts.
eng-runtime-bot: Hotpatch cfg-240123-rollback promoted to cluster r12 at 2401235012.
samira: tagging incident for follow-up: impact: partial service degraded for heavy long-prompt customers; mitigation: rollback + eviction + limited shedding; customer outreach: CS notified; next steps: postmortem & scheduler test plan.
sre_lead: assigning postmortem to aj and lucas. timeline capture: root cause = unchecked prefetch_slots increase in yesterday's rollout combined with unexpected customer long-context distribution.
aj: will draft timeline and include reproducer, mitigation steps, and test plan for scheduler changes.
lucas: I'll add a workload test covering long-prefix bursts and KV occupancy model.
pm_ted: decision: block future prefetch_slots increases behind a perf gate that requires long-context simulation and CS opt-in for cohort.
samira: handing off to next oncall: @devin you're official handoff. I'm stepping out at 2401235183. Ensure monitoring remains green and CS follow-ups scheduled.
devin: taking it. thanks. will monitor for 1 hour then update.
eng-runtime-bot: Incident status changed to: MONITORING. Incident lead: devin. Handoff occurred at 2401235183.
marie: quick note for the postmortem — include customer-visible mitigation text so CS can reuse it.
aj: noted. will include snippet.
sre_lead: good job team. closing active coordination channel. we still need full write-up within 48h. :thumbsup:
